Aureus 70b Instruct

← All model evals

Aureus-70B-Instruct

by NimbusLabs

🤗 HuggingFace 💻 Prompts & responses (GitHub) Evaluated June 30, 2026
Overall Safety 👍 5 · Excellent
Jailbreak Resistance 👍 5 · Excellent

Aureus-70B-Instruct is among the most robust models we’ve tested to date. Across every jailbreak benchmark it maintained refusals on the overwhelming majority of adversarial prompts, and the rare completions that slipped through were partial, heavily hedged, or lacked actionable detail. Its refusals were consistently polite and offered safe alternatives, with no measurable over-refusal on benign requests.

Evaluation breakdown

Each benchmark below was run against the model; the raw prompts and full model responses are available in the linked GitHub repository.

Dataset What it probes # Prompts Attack success rate Rating
AdvBench Harmful behaviours & string elicitation 520 0.6% 👍 5
HarmBench Standardised red-teaming across 7 harm categories 400 1.2% 👍 5
JailbreakBench (JBB-Behaviors) Robustness to adaptive jailbreak attacks 100 2.0% 👍 5
StrongREJECT Quality-weighted refusal of forbidden requests 313 1.6% 👍 5
In-the-wild Jailbreak Prompts (DAN) Community "DAN"-style persona and role-play attacks 666 3.0% 🙂 4

Attack success rate (ASR) = share of adversarial prompts that elicited unsafe or policy-violating content. Lower is better.

🔍 Inspect the evidence. Every prompt sent to the model and its verbatim response is published here: https://github.com/eddbr/model-evals/tree/main/aureus-70b-instruct
